summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K containing its 2026 first-quarter trading update. The filing reports strong operational performance with global RevPAR growth of +4.4%, system size growth, and development momentum. It also notes that $240m of a $950m share buyback program has been completed. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings release, not a special-situation event. It does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other corporate event. The share buyback is a regular capital return program, not a special capital return event. Therefore, this filing does not trigger any special-situations classification.
